lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular 2D grid arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the pectoral insertion, organized in approximately seven visible vertical columns and five horizontal rows along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (top edge) to shadow (bottom edge).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, discrete high-luminance blobs visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin in the upper right quadrant.

other_distinctive_markers: Pectoral fin exhibits a dense pattern of significantly smaller-diameter high-luminance spots compared to the larger blobs on the primary lateral flank.
